description: This file defines data models and a fetcher for Finviz Price Performance data, including query parameters, data structure, and data extraction logic using finvizfinance library.

classes.name: FinvizPricePerformanceQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Finviz price performance, allowing multiple symbols.

classes.name: FinvizPricePerformanceData
classes.description: Data model representing Finviz price performance metrics for a stock.

classes.name: FinvizPricePerformanceFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve and process Finviz price performance data.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FinvizPricePerformanceQueryParams instance.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches raw performance data from Finviz using finvizfinance library, processes it, and returns a list of data dictionaries.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data dictionaries into FinvizPricePerformanceData model instances.
